purpose: Pinned concurrent baseline adapters, API semantics and complete-operation smoke check; not a candidate comparison or scaling result.
asan_source: source/asan (only final quiescent-read commentary differs from Release header)
pinned_dependencies: Reacquired from the immutable/hash-checked public URLs in captured CMake; vendor archives and toolchain are not duplicated in this bundle.
timing_qualification: Local AArch64 OrbStack VM; no CPU pinning and one repetition. Thread creation/input setup excluded; measured ingestion barriers, online growth, protected full-value consume and destruction. No winner/scalability/ISA claim.
quiescent_read_qualification: GTL consume<true> uses if_contains_unsafe only after all mutations stop. Boost still uses cvisit; native downgrade is a separate unmeasured ownership operation.
